Ranma 1/2 (2024) 3rd Season Anime Overview:

The modern adaptation of Rumiko Takahashi's classic martial arts romantic comedy continues in its third season, following the chaotic daily life of Ranma Saotome and Akane Tendo. Bound by an arrangement between their fathers, the teenage duo are reluctantly engaged to inherit the Tendo dojo. Their lives are further complicated by a cursed spring in China that causes Ranma to transform into a girl upon contact with cold water, while hot water restores his male form. As various eccentric martial artists, childhood rivals, and fiancées enter the fray, Ranma and Akane must navigate high school attendance, martial arts challenges, and their own complicated feelings while managing the constant disruptions brought on by the curse and their colorful cast of peers.

Japanese Title: らんま1/2 (2024) 第3期

Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru! Anime Overview:

Set at Fujinasu Academy, a prestigious private institution situated outside the city, the story follows first-year student Ume Mizunoe. Although he excels in Japanese literature and boasts numerous writing awards, his failing grades in science threaten to hold him back a year. To salvage his academic status and secure his progression to the next grade, he joins the school student council. Within this eccentric administrative body, he encounters a diverse group of peers, including the enigmatic student council president Kotobuki Hisako, the imposing yet gentle treasurer Arisu Terui, the playful junior Tan Otori, and the shy administrative assistant Komaro Michinoku. This setup initiates a comedic romantic everyday life focused on the chaotic daily routines of these uniquely flawed student leaders.

Japanese Title: 生徒会にも穴はある！

Official Site: https://nama-anaru.com/

images.alt:
A highly detailed 3D cinematic render of Jack Skellington from The Nightmare Before Christmas, sitting casually on a large glowing jack-o'-lantern. Jack has a white skull face with black eye sockets, stitched mouth, and a thin skeletal neck. He wears his classic black pinstripe suit with a large black bat-wing bow tie. His pose is relaxed and elegant: one long skeletal leg crossed over the other, one bony hand raised near his face with fingers delicately curled, the other hand resting on the pumpkin. The oversized orange pumpkin has a classic carved grinning face with triangular eyes and a jagged smile, glowing warmly from within with bright orange light that illuminates Jack from below. 

Background features a massive full moon dominating the upper half of the frame, glowing soft white-blue against a deep purple and indigo night sky filled with stars and subtle wispy clouds. Sparse leafless trees and dark grassy hills frame the bottom. Moody Halloween atmosphere, dramatic lighting, high detail, sharp focus, cinematic composition, vertical orientation, in the distinctive Tim Burton stop-motion style mixed with modern high-quality 3D rendering.
